question: 'Thaipoosam’ festival is celebrated in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Thaipoosam is a Hindu festival celebrated mainly by the Tamil community in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu and the Union Territory of Puducherry.**
 
• It is also celebrated by Tamil communities in other parts of India and around the world, such as in **Malaysia, Singapore, Sri Lanka, and Mauritius**.
 
• The festival is typically observed in the **Tamil month of Thai (January/February) **on the day of the** full moon**, and is dedicated to **Lord Murugan, the Hindu god of war and victory.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Bihar, a state in eastern India,** is known for its diverse cultural heritage and a number of festivals are celebrated here throughout the year.

 
 
• One of the most famous festivals of Bihar is** Chhath Puja**, which is dedicated to the worship of the Sun God and **Chhathi Maiya.**
 
• It is usually celebrated in the month o**f October or November **and is a four-day long festival, where devotees offer prayers and perform rituals to seek blessings for the well-being of their families and loved ones.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh, a state in southern India, is known for its rich cultural heritage and diverse traditions.**
 
 
• One of the most famous festivals celebrated in **Andhra Pradesh** is the **Sankranti festival,** which marks the end of the winter solstice and the beginning of the harvest season.
 
• **Sankranti** is celebrated with great enthusiasm and is a four-day long festival, during which people decorate their houses, prepare special dishes, and fly kites.
 
 
 
• **Goa, a state on the western coast of India, is known for its beautiful beaches, vibrant nightlife, and unique blend of Indian and Portuguese cultures.**
 
 
• One of the most famous festivals celebrated in Goa is the Carnival, which is a four-day long celebration that usually takes place in February.
 
• The festival is a colorful and lively event, with parades, music, dance, and street performances.
